description: Dependency updates for a solo project with about ten users. Renovate's JSON does not allow comments, so the reasoning lives in these description fields.

NOTHING AUTO-MERGES, anywhere in this file, including patches and including security fixes. A merge to main here is a production deploy: the droplet's coc-update.timer pulls main every five minutes and runs deploy/update.sh, with no human in the path. An automerged PR is therefore an unreviewed deploy, and the CI workflow can tell you a commit is broken but cannot stop the timer shipping it. Every Renovate PR gets read before it lands.
Volume is capped deliberately. There is one maintainer, and a wall of open dependency PRs would bury the one signal the Verify workflow exists to give.
See docs/setup.md for the Node pin and deploy/README.md for the timer.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Advisories are raised out of schedule and past the concurrent limit, because an advisory is the one update worth interrupting a week for. It still does not automerge — a security patch is a deploy like any other.

packageRules.description: One PR a week for everything non-major. These are the updates that are almost always fine, and reading one diff is the whole point of grouping them; a per-package PR for each would be the wall of noise this config exists to avoid.
Majors stay one PR each, unlabeled by any group. A major is a change to read on its own, and it is the case where an unreviewed deploy would actually hurt.

Node itself is pinned exactly, in .nvmrc and in the CI workflow, because node:sqlite is experimental and is the entire persistence layer. Renovate may move that pin within 22.x only: production installs Node from deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x, so a bump to 23 or 24 here would silently point local dev and CI at a different major from the droplet — which is the divergence docs/setup.md exists to warn about, not one to automate. Raising the major is a deliberate decision that has to include the host.

A Node bump touches .nvmrc and .github/workflows/verify.yml together and must stay out of the grouped dependency PR, so that moving the runtime is never something you find inside a diff you opened to read about a lint plugin.
